result.final_answer:
I now have comprehensive information from both the Apple Watch comparison page and the Apple Newsroom article. Let me provide a complete summary of the updates for Apple Watch Series 7, 8, and 9.

## Summary of Updates for Apple Watch Series 7, 8, and 9 on Apple's Website

Based on my research of Apple's website, I found updates about these watches from two sources:
1. The **Apple Watch comparison page** (`apple.com/watch/compare/`)
2. The **Apple Newsroom article** titled "Major updates for Apple's software platforms are now available" (September 14, 2026)

### 📱 Software Update: watchOS 27 (Major Software Update – September 14, 2026)

Apple has released **watchOS 27** which brings significant updates, with varying compatibility across the three watches:

**Features for Apple Watch Series 7, 8, and 9 (where compatible):**
- **Apple Intelligence & Siri AI**: New conversational Siri powered by next-gen Apple Intelligence. ⚠️ **Only available on Apple Watch Series 9 or later, Apple Watch Ultra 2 or later, and Apple Watch SE 3** (when paired with Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone). So Series 7 and 8 are **not supported**.
- **New Smart Stack widget suggestions** that surface when relevant (general Apple Watch feature)
- **Single-handed tap gesture** to conveniently open widgets
- **Workout Buddy** now works even without iPhone nearby, and is available in Spanish (in addition to English)
- **Faster music playback** on Apple Watch
- **Health app**: Added perimenopause and menopause support in Cycle Tracking with cycle deviation notifications

### 📊 Feature Differences Between Series 7, 8, and 9

| Feature | Series 7 | Series 8 | Series 9 |
|---------|----------|----------|----------|
| Display brightness | Up to 1000 nits | Up to 1000 nits | Up to 2000 nits |
| Case materials | Aluminum, Stainless Steel, **Titanium** | Aluminum, Stainless Steel | Aluminum, Stainless Steel |
| Chip | S7 | S8 | S9 |
| Apple Intelligence / Siri AI | ❌ Not supported | ❌ Not supported | ✅ Yes |
| Wrist temperature sensing | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Sleep apnea notifications | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Sleep score | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Hypertension notifications | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ (NEW) |
| Crash Detection | Fall Detection only | ✅ | ✅ |
| Double tap / Wrist flick gesture | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Precision Finding for iPhone | Find iPhone only | Find iPhone only | ✅ Precision Finding |
| Battery life | 18 hours | 18 hours | 18 hours (36h Low Power) |
| Fast charge (0-80%) | 45 min | 45 min | 45 min |
| Vitals app | HR, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, sleep | + wrist temperature | + (no blood oxygen) |
| Cycle Tracking w/ improved predictions | Basic | ✅ Improved | ✅ Improved |
| Perimenopause/menopause support | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| ECG, HRV, Heart rate notifications | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Blood Oxygen app | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Always-On Retina OLED/LTPO | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| GPS + Cellular options | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Water resistant 50m + Swim | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Emergency SOS | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

### 🔑 Key Takeaway

The major recent **"update"** for these three watches is the **watchOS 27 release** (rolled out September 14, 2026), which introduces **Apple Intelligence/Siri AI but only supports Apple Watch Series 9 or later** — meaning Series 7 and 8 won't receive Apple's latest AI features. However, all three watches benefit from general Apple Watch platform improvements including Smart Stack widget suggestions, Workout Buddy enhancements, and faster music playback.
